text:
sara: quick sync: I'm proposing an "ingest gatekeeper" pattern instead of merging lanes outright. idea: single ingress envelope but a small deterministic gate in the router decides routing and enrichment policy based on a handful of header flags. goal: reduce duplicate parsing while keeping billing determinism + query compatibility. thoughts? :thinking:
dennis: sounds promising. key constraints: 1) router must deterministically resolve billing (no ambiguity), 2) minimal header decode must be very cheap (<1ms p50), 3) backfills/materializers must be idempotent so we don't change historical billing.
yara: agree with dennis. prefer gatekeeper to heavyweight unification. propose header tiers: GATE (route,billing_token,trace_id,quota_key,checksum), POLICY (retention_hint,sample_mode,materialize_policy), REF (body_ref,meta_ref). Router only parses GATE.
sara: here's a strawman header snippet I put in the draft RFC:
```json
{"gate":{"billing_token":"btok-77","trace_id":"t-0a1b","quota_key":"acct-55","arrival_ts":1712340000},"policy":{"retention":"long","sample_mode":"stable_hash","materialize":"on_demand"},"ref":{"body_ref":"s3://ingest/2026/part-0001.avro","checksum":"sha256:abc...","schema_v":"v4"}}
```
matt: tracing concern: if materialization is async, we must ensure trace_id is carried through and that enrichers include trace_id when they write enriched attrs. stitcher then joins by trace_id+checksum. also include optional span_hint to help reconstruction if client-side spans exist.
dennis: billing determinism: router must resolve billing_token->billing_key synchronously from a small cached store (with watch updates). If lookups miss, envelope goes to quarantine queue and a retry path; we cannot let billing_key be unresolved because it breaks chargeback. add billing_resolve_status in metadata for observability.
yara: sampling: two modes: stable_hash (deterministic per-request hash) and opportunistic. If sample_mode==stable_hash and billing_token absent, we route to sampled path and set sample_hash for stable replays/backfills. If billing_token present, materialize_policy must be full. add sample_version to header.
sara: agreed. materializer rules: idempotent based on checksum+schema_v and write a materialization_manifest with materializer_id and materialization_time. If a late materialization occurs after billing window, materializer should emit a bill_snapshot record rather than mutate prior invoice state.
matt: query compatibility: we should keep a compact join-index mapping body_ref -> enriched_attrs (and manifest) in a low-latency store. ad-hoc queries either join at query time or use a cached materialized view. index TTL derived from retention_hint.
dennis: perf: infra must run a header-only decode bench across a representative sample. target p50 < 1ms and p95 < 4ms. if fail -> fallback to two-lane approach. @bot-deploy can you kick a perf job?
bot-deploy: perf job queued: ci/obs/ingest-gatekeeper-header-decode-4991239876. ETA 14h. Link: https://ci.redwood/obs/bench/4991239876 :gear:
yara: migration plan sketch: 1) accept gatekeeper envelopes alongside lanes, 2) enable gate routing for low-risk tenants (5%), 3) validate billing p95/latency & join-index correctness, 4) expand cohorts and flip billing tenants last. rollback: routers have per-cohort policy switch. rollback window 1h for small cohorts, 3h for billing cohorts.
sara: alerts & metrics to monitor: billing_resolution_failures, billing_latency_p50/p95, parser_cpu_ms_p50, attr_cardinality_growth, join-index-hit-rate, materializer-error-rate. set burn thresholds for top-20 tenants.
matt: stitcher implementation note: stitcher should treat trace_id+checksum as primary join key, with span_hint as tie-breaker. dedupe using last_seen_manifest to prevent double materialization. also surface a reconcile diff when materialization disagrees with previous snapshots.
dennis: operational corner-case: reprocessing a body_ref after format upgrade. materializers must honor schema_v and either run migration adapters or route to quarantine. include schema_v in gate header to allow early routing decisions.
yara: cost accounting: to avoid double-charge from analytics sampling and billing, normalize billing attribution to use billing_key + materialization_manifest time. For sampled analytics we should emit 'sampled_telemetry' events flagged clearly so downstream billing ignores them.
sara: action items: 1) I'll update the RFC with gate header schema + sample modes + materializer manifest spec + migration checklist. 2) @dennis infra perf bench. 3) @matt prototype stitcher interface and dedupe strategy. 4) @yara own join-index design and TTL semantics. target sync next Tue. :white_check_mark:
dennis: noted. I'll post perf numbers and cache sizing estimates tomorrow.
matt: will mock stitcher in the sidecar repo this week.
yara: will draft join-index API and retention enforcement doc.
sara: thanks all. filing this under rfc/ingest-gatekeeper-4991239876 (draft). link will be added once RFC created. :rocket:
